title: His parents' work and the Thomas family
summary: Thomas describes his father as an all-around man, his mother's cooking, his siblings Cleora, George and Joe, and the free house they lived in.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Foots, I want to ask you about... Before we get all the way out of school, just go back a little bit about your family, about your mother and your father. What
did your father do for a living?
Well, my father was a... Oh, he was an all-around man. He cut... He took care of lawns. He cooked in...

No, he was at home. And my mother was the most sensational cook.. I often... I asked my sister. My mother...I couldn't understand it. She never had too much formal training. But she could cook. She made the best pies and cakes...
Well, there was four of us. I have two brothers and one sister.
Cleora. And my brother is George. You've met George.
And Joe. And we had a couple of more in my family that passed on. Because there was a daughter that was next to me; she passed.
Well, how did your father support ...(?)...
Well, my father worked for some family in Muskogee. This guy, I think, was a candy salesman or something. And we had a home free. Evidently he owned that

property we was on. We didn't pay no rent. And we learned to get out and cut grass, and my mother used to do laundry and do that baking stuff. Because in my senior year, between my junior and senior year...
